mainEntity.name: What factors determine the cost of adding a guest apartment?

acceptedAnswer.text: Total costs depend on whether the project is an interior conversion, an attached room addition, or a detached new build. Primary cost drivers include running dedicated plumbing lines for a new bathroom, upgrading your home's electrical panel to handle additional circuits, and installing independent heating and cooling, such as a ductless mini-split system. Material selections for cabinetry, countertops, tile, and fixtures also significantly move the budget. During the estimating process, an on-site consultation helps establish the exact scope, structural requirements, and finish levels to provide tailored pricing. Bay City Remodeling also offers negotiable pricing and veteran discounts.
acceptedAnswer.description: Costs are driven by whether the space is a conversion or new build, utility trenching, electrical panel capacity, bathroom plumbing, HVAC requirements, and finish materials.
